locator.section: The Most Holy Name of Jesus, Collect body

entries.claim: Historical English basis of the prayer body, revised against the Latin in contemporary language. This page abbreviates the conclusion as Through the same, &c.; it does not print the expanded ending and is not evidence for the 1962 calendar placement.

locator.section: Libera nos, expanded conclusion and duration

entries.claim: Historical basis for the expanded conclusion and duration, revised for the selected Latin: same is retained and our is supplied for nostrum; address and Holy Spirit terminology are modernized. World without end is rendered forever and ever. This is a formula in Libera nos, not the Holy Name Collect's abbreviated ending printed in full.
